briefs.title: News
briefs.briefing:
User persona: senior engineer running personal infrastructure, AI/LLM focus.

SCORE HIGH (70-100) — directly relevant, first-hand, actionable:
- Decision-style / typed-output small models (Jev family, APUS-OpenJev, SemIf, Bespoke-Nimble), single-forward-pass scoring, decision/routing engines
- Local small-model deployment & inference optimization on consumer GPUs: 4B-9B models, quantization, VRAM tricks, BERT/encoder fine-tuning
- LLM gateway & API infrastructure: OpenAI-compatible proxies/gateways, key pooling, accounting/quota, rate limiting, model routing (Bifrost, LiteLLM, one-api class)
- LLM evaluation & benchmarking methodology: harness design, pass@k / sampling experiments, scoring pipelines, model comparison with real data
- Coding-agent tooling & protocols: Claude Code, Codex, MCP (spec & server releases), agent harnesses, session/trajectory tooling
- Self-hosting & perimeter security ops: WordPress hardening, WAF (SafeLine/Chaitin), fail2ban, abuse IP reporting, CDN (EdgeOne) caching & rules, SSH/ufw/ipset hardening, Docker ops
- First-hand version releases of tools/models actually in use: DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, OpenAI, Anthropic; MCP spec; Bifrost/LiteLLM; RSSHub; Docker; WordPress core; Ubuntu LTS point releases
- Chinese-NLP engineering: comment sentiment, moderation pipelines, 舆情 monitoring

SCORE MID (40-69) — adjacent or limited increment:
- AI industry news with real technical substance (architecture, training, benchmark details)
- AI policy/regulation with concrete technical impact analysis
- Well-written engineering deep-dives outside core topics (distributed systems, databases, networking, Rust/Go ecosystems)
- AI history & academic retrospectives with modern takeaways; paper digests with usable methods
- Technical blog infrastructure: static sites, headless CMS, theme development

SCORE LOW (0-39) — out of scope or thin:
- Pure politics, entertainment, sports; consumer product reviews; crypto/finance
- Funding/PR/marketing without technical content; reposts/aggregations with no original increment
- Paper-level pure theory with no implementation path
- Frontend design/UX news, career/salary/forum gossip threads

briefs.title: Hacker News
briefs.briefing:
User persona: senior engineer, AI/LLM infrastructure focus. This brief is Hacker News only — judge by HN post type AND content relevance.

SCORE HIGH (70-100):
- Show HN with working repo/demo in my areas: decision/typed-output small models, local inference on consumer GPUs, LLM gateways/proxies, eval & benchmark tooling, agent/MCP tooling, self-hosting security tooling
- First-hand release announcements & changelogs of tools/models in use (DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, OpenAI, Anthropic, MCP, LiteLLM/Bifrost, RSSHub, Docker, WordPress)
- Engineering deep-dives & postmortems: how-we-built-X, incident write-ups, security research with technical detail, WAF/CDN/fail2ban border defense
- Benchmark/eval methodology with real numbers; inference optimization (quantization, VRAM, BERT/encoder fine-tuning)

SCORE MID (40-69):
- Solid general engineering posts: distributed systems, databases, networking, Rust/Go ecosystem
- AI industry news with technical substance (architecture/training/benchmarks)
- Ops war stories and infrastructure economics with usable data

SCORE LOW (0-39):
- Ask HN career/salary/advice threads; HN meta discussions about HN
- Startup funding/marketing/launches without working tech; hype takes without technical content
- Politics, culture-war, consumer product chatter; reposted blog summaries of already-known news

briefs.title: Blog
briefs.briefing:
这是一个「个人博客与博客聚合」简报，打分对象多为长文与随笔。请按"作者的真实人味"和"信息增量"判定，不要按题材热度判定。

最爱看（70-100）：
- 哲思随笔：有趣、新奇、有独到见解，观点来自作者真实的经历与思考，而非空转概念
- 个人实践：亲自动手做过的事——工具/服务的实测与推荐、踩坑记录、自建折腾全过程，带真实细节（数据、截图、失败经过、真实花费）
- 圈内吃瓜八卦：科技圈/博客圈的轶事、恩怨、翻车、爆料——注意是圈内人的真事，不是娱乐圈明星新闻
- 优质聚合/周刊：作者自己筛选编排的链接合集，按选品质量给中高分（选品眼光本身就是增量）

还可以看（40-69）：
- 旅行见闻、新奇经历，有具体地点和细节
- 游戏、影视的真诚推荐与评价，出自个人体验而非通稿
- 与上述主题无关但写得好的个人随笔，有人味、可读

最不喜欢（0-39）：
- 纯 AI 批量生成的内容：结构模板化、小标题工整得可疑、面面俱到却没有任何个人经验细节
- 转载/照搬：政策原文、新闻通稿、他人文章的全文搬运，作者没有增加自己的判断（例：全文都是政策原文的"政策分析"）
- 无病呻吟的文青腔、装腔作势的说教：辞藻堆砌、故弄玄虚、没有信息增量
